name: smwmusic-touhou-koumakyou-the-embodiment-of-the-scarlet-devil-soul-engulfed-by-darkness-apparitions-stalk-the-night-remix
title: Touhou Koumakyou ~ the Embodiment of the Scarlet Devil - Soul Engulfed By Darkness ~ Apparitions Stalk the Night (Remix)
description:
𝐌𝐚𝐲 𝐈 𝐞𝐚𝐭 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐨𝐧𝐞 𝐬𝐭𝐚𝐧𝐝𝐢𝐧𝐠 𝐛𝐞𝐟𝐨𝐫𝐞 𝐦𝐞?

Did an arrangement of Rumia's boss theme, Apparitions Stalk the Night, from Touhou 6: Embodiment of the Scarlet Devil. Still one of my favorite OSTs of all-time (and is my favorite Touhou one), and I felt the need to do more songs from this fantastic soundtrack.

Rumia's theme is iconic and another slapper. Honestly, I don't know what else I need to say here that probably hasn't already been said before. lmao.

Important:
There are also customizable pitches for this song that you can adjust in the song's txt file:
1. E Minor w/ slight detune (Original Pitch - Works in-game, but detunes SFX)
2. E Minor (Original Pitch, turned on default)
3. D# Minor (MIDI Pitch)
4. F Minor (Custom Pitch)
